precedence: In these clauses use shared.md, the three operative papers and model-02.1.tex in place of Edition 02 conflicting equations, TOKEN or RECONCILE listings and associated text.

A1.transaction: validate selector, snapshot once, fresh disjoint scratch per call, retain checked selected update/token/guard, one atomic commit on accepted committing path only
A1.exit: private=0, conflict=0, unresolved=0, rejected=0, failed atomic commit=0, accepted committing=1

A2.domain: finite native raw vector at every ID
A2.allowed: native repetition support intersect native page support; source and guard-state bound
A2.phase_bits: replace newly banned indices with native negative infinity and preserve the supplied immediate predecessor elsewhere, byte-exact
A2.winner: least allowed ID on a tie incl signed zero
A2.missing: U absent required evidence; visible conflicts dominate while missing keys are retained

C1.exact: uniform equal-cost expected remaining candidate count: minimize sum squared varying-field bucket counts, ties lowest field ID
C1.noisy: history-conditioned expected posterior squared-norm gain; positive only, equal costs, ties lowest action ID
C1.eligibility: primitive source unused and conditional likelihood identified
C1.termination: zero marginal MODEL_CONFLICT; threshold ACCEPT; exhausted budget or no informative unused actions UNRESOLVED; missing live observation retained and unresolved
C1.used_source: repeated deterministic read leaves posterior and acquisition budget unchanged
